The '''ISO 14064''' series sets out the international standards for quantifying, reporting and verifying greenhouse gas emissions.

Where the [[GHG Protocol]] provides an accounting method and [[Bilan Carbone]] an operational approach, ISO 14064 provides an '''auditable''' framework. It is the standard third-party verification bodies rely on.

; ISO 14064-1
: quantification and reporting at '''organisation''' level
; ISO 14064-2
: quantification and reporting at '''project''' level
; ISO 14064-3
: '''validation and verification''' of declarations

== Related standards ==

ISO 14067 covers the carbon footprint of a '''product''', based on [[Life cycle assessment|life cycle assessment]] principles. ISO 14040 and ISO 14044 define LCA itself. ISO 14001 covers environmental management systems.
